limitations: All loads are source-bound conditional V11 mechanics-model actions; no physical force bounds, delivered joint qualification, or structural acceptance are asserted.

Each paired-plywood action is one 38.1 mm perfect-bond analysis-host wrench joined to both actual 19.05 mm leaf geometry records. No leaf load split, bond qualification, or doubled capacity is inferred.
Individual host forces and free couples are preserved, replayed from raw receiver-port actions, and group moments are transported without discarding free couples.

Net force grain/edge signs and signed angles are actual resultants of the recorded actions. They do not assign NDS loaded edge/end when oblique loading, local reversals, group eccentricity, pressure reversal, or free-couple effects are unresolved.

Two-edge 4D values are optional geometry-only envelope markers, not automatic NDS failures. End, edge, spacing, and pairwise quarter-spacing outputs remain separate from complete group classification/capacity.
No historical 068/069 sign or force result is imported; both are recomputed from the caller-supplied six-case V11 bank.
Actual Cg, Cdelta, complete connection/group capacity, splitting, independent flange couple capacity, and physical response are null/unqualified.
V4 geometry-only end/edge station distances are reused only through the pinned exact V3/V4 profile, axis, and finished-BRep equivalence proof. V4 force or acceptance results are not reused.
